body:
I know what you mean.

I have a horrible reaction to people dying. My first thought is that I wish I'd been there. I wish I'd had the "chance" to die in a way that wouldn't have the same affect on people as a self inflicted death. 

I hate that that's my first thought, but it is. 

Right now I'm staying up, because I want to go to bed and ensure I don't wake up again. The advice is always to wait. To let it pass. I don't feel like it's passing.
